title: SyntheticData
summary: A Flask-based web application backend offering both single-table and multi-table synthetic data generation with quality evaluation endpoints. It is built directly on SDV, calling GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and HMASynthesizer to fit and sample synthetic data and evaluate_quality to score the results.
evidence: Single Table/backend/server.py:130-137 GaussianCopulaSynthesizer(metadata).fit/.sample + evaluate_quality; Multi Table/backend/server.py:467-469 HMASynthesizer(metadata).fit
needs: No README; repo purpose inferred solely from server.py code paths for single- and multi-table synthesis endpoints.
